headline: Sunday discipline: stop the snacking spiral now
summary: You're gaining 0.62 kg/week when you need to lose 0.81 kg/week—today's Sunday choices will either compound your deficit or start reversing it.
details: Today: eat only whole-food vegan meals or Huel portions; avoid all emotional snacking, refined carbs, and 'just one more' mentality that dominates your Sundays. Commit to 45 minutes on the rowing machine or treadmill—this burns energy and interrupts the snacking impulse. Why today: you're 303 days from your 88 kg goal and losing 1.43 kg/week to the wrong direction; every Sunday you reclaim is momentum reclaimed.
